% !tp-example Basic usage
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
\wcTpCsvTable[heading]{
  \wcScript[type=tp/csv-table]|
    Country,Capital
    Estonia,Tallinn
    Latvia,Riga
    Lithuania,Vilnius
  |
}
\end{document}

% !tp-example Javascript API
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
\wcScript[type=module]|
import "/components/csv-table/csv-table.js";

const example = document.createDocumentFragment();

const element1 = document.createElement("tp-csv-table");
element1.setAttribute("heading", "");
element1.append(document.createTextNode("\n  "));

const element2 = document.createElement("script");
element2.setAttribute("type", "tp/csv-table");
element2.textContent = "\n    Country,Capital\n    Estonia,Tallinn\n    Latvia,Riga\n    Lithuania,Vilnius\n  ";
element1.append(element2);
element1.append(document.createTextNode("\n"));
example.append(element1);

document.body.append(example);
|
\end{document}

% !tp-example Quoted fields
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
\wcTpCsvTable[heading,separator=;]{
  \wcScript[type=tp/csv-table]|
Name;Note
"Ada; Lovelace";"A quoted ""word"""
Grace;"First line
Second line"
|
}
\end{document}
